name: Advanced Customer Account for WooCommerce
author: Noor Alam

sections.description:
Advanced Customer Account for WooCommerce transforms your WooCommerce My Account page into a modern, fast, and beautiful customer portal. Built with React and the WordPress REST API, it provides a seamless single-page application (SPA) experience that your customers will love.

✨ Key Features

Modern Dashboard
* Welcome message with customer name and avatar
* Quick stats showing total orders, money spent, and member since date
* Recent orders with status badges
* Profile completeness indicator
* One-click quick actions

Orders Management
* Beautiful orders list with pagination
* Detailed order view with items, totals, and tracking
* Order status badges with color coding
* View order notes and details

Downloads Section
* View all purchased downloadable products
* Download remaining count
* Expiration date display
* One-click download buttons

Address Management
* Edit billing and shipping addresses
* Country and state dropdowns
* Form validation
* Clean, modern interface

Profile Settings
* Update display name and email
* Change password securely
* Profile completeness tracking

🎨 Beautiful Design

  • Clean, Modern UI – Carefully crafted interface that looks great on any theme
  • Fully Responsive – Perfect experience on desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Fast & Smooth – React-powered SPA with instant navigation
  • Consistent Styling – Uses CSS custom properties for easy customization

🔧 Easy Setup

The plugin automatically replaces your WooCommerce My Account page – no configuration needed! Simply install, activate, and your customers will see the new beautiful account page.

Alternatively, use the [aca_my_account] shortcode on any page to display the customer account area.

🛡️ Built with Best Practices

  • WordPress Coding Standards – Follows all WordPress and WooCommerce coding standards
  • Secure – Proper nonce verification, data sanitization, and capability checks
  • Translation Ready – Fully internationalized with text domain
  • Performance Optimized – Efficient API calls with proper caching

💡 Perfect For

  • Online stores wanting a modern customer experience
  • WooCommerce sites needing a beautiful My Account page
  • Developers looking for a solid foundation to extend
  • Businesses that value customer satisfaction

🔌 Compatibility

  • WordPress 6.0+
  • WooCommerce 8.0+
  • PHP 7.4+
  • Works with any properly coded WordPress theme

🌐 Languages

  • English (default)
  • Translation ready (POT file included)

Privacy Policy

Advanced Customer Account for WooCommerce does not:
* Track users
* Collect any personal data
* Send data to external servers
* Use cookies beyond WordPress defaults

The plugin only displays existing WooCommerce customer data through a new interface.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Advanced Customer Account for WooCommerce”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. That’s it! Visit your My Account page to see the new design

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Using FTP

  1. Extract the plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload the advanced-customer-account folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, Advanced Customer Account is designed specifically for WooCommerce and requires WooCommerce 8.0 or higher to function.

Will it work with my theme?

Yes! The plugin is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme. It uses isolated CSS that won’t conflict with your theme styles.

Can I use this alongside the default WooCommerce My Account?

The plugin automatically replaces the WooCommerce My Account page. If you want to use both, you can disable the auto-replacement in settings and use the [aca_my_account] shortcode on a different page.

Is it mobile responsive?

Absolutely! The plugin is fully responsive and provides an excellent experience on all devices – desktop, tablet, and mobile.

Can I customize the colors?

Yes, the plugin uses CSS custom properties (variables) that can be easily overridden in your theme’s custom CSS.

Does it support multiple languages?

Yes, the plugin is fully translation-ready with all strings properly internationalized.

Will my customers lose their order history?

No! The plugin simply provides a new interface for viewing the same WooCommerce data. All orders, addresses, and account information remain intact.

How do I report bugs or request features?

Please use the support forum on WordPress.org or contact us through our website.
